NYMPH_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_THOUGHT.title: Thought/Confusion Threshold/Obstruction Threshold
NYMPH_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_THOUGHT.descrip:
Whenever you play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] Thought.
The Obstruction Threshold is [blue]2[/blue] times the Confusion Threshold.
[green]Clear[/green]: Whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
[orange]Confused[/orange]: No special effect.
[red]Obstructed[/red]: Whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card, take [blue]1[/blue] damage.
NYMPH_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_THOUGHT.heavyDe:
Whenever you play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] Thought.
The Obstruction Threshold is [blue]2[/blue] times the Confusion Threshold.
[green]Clear[/green]: Whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
[orange]Confused[/orange]: Lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
[red]Obstructed[/red]: Lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]; whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card, take [blue]1[/blue] damage.

NYMPH_DURABILITY.title: Durability
NYMPH_DURABILITY.description: Whenever this card is played, lose 1 Durability. At 0, remove this card from your deck.
NYMPH_DISCOVERY.title: Discover
NYMPH_DISCOVERY.description: Choose one of three random cards to add to your Hand. That card can be played for free this turn.
NYMPH_CARDPILE_INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration Pile
NYMPH_CARDPILE_INSPIRATION.description:
Stores the Inspiration Cards you obtain.
At the start of combat, you may choose one of them to play.
